adapter.rgb_expansion: channel * 85 (accepted harness expansion); the ROM stores 2 bits per channel

rom_native.backdrop: CRAM[16 + (R7 & 15)]: R7 = 0, so sprite-palette entry 0. Results card: record 4 entry 0 = $3F (white, same as the fill tile and the bg index 13). Act title card: only the BG slot is faded in, so the sprite palette is still black: black left column and black border.

adapter.status: GAMEMAKER PRESENTATION ADAPTER PROPOSAL - not ROM data; the ROM facts are in every other section

tally_rate.note: a step is ~19.5k T-states without a button and ~9.9k with one; per 50 Hz frame the same code gives ~1.19x more steps. Choose the adapter rate from the target frame rate; do not treat the per-frame figure as a ROM constant.

widescreen_348x196.note: centre the 256x192 image; paint the 46-px side bars and 2-px top/bottom bars with the ROM backdrop colour of the same frame and run them through the same CRAM ramp as the image (the backdrop is part of CRAM, so it fades with the card)

routines.name: act_clear_tail
routines.role: main-loop branch for D293 bit 5: fades, results, tally, act += 1, reload request

routines.name: zone_clear_tail
routines.role: main-loop branch for D293 bit 4 (act index 2): same tail, zone gate, zone += 1

routines.name: results_card
routines.role: card draw: tile load, fill, banner, labels, panel, continue icons, numbers, fade-in, 60-wait, tally

routines.name: emerald_icons
routines.role: up to five 2x2 emerald icons from D2CC bits 0..4

routines.name: palette_white_fill
routines.role: fills the palette buffer D472..D491 with $3F

routines.name: results_tile_loader
routines.role: bank 19, VRAM $2000, tile stream $949C through the $24C2 decoder

routines.name: tally_loops
routines.role: ring loop (10 raw per ring) then bonus-word loop (1 raw per step)

routines.name: tally_boss_bonus
routines.role: act index 2 only: N steps of 10 raw (N from the table at $2D84)

routines.name: tally_boss_table
routines.role: six 16-bit step counts, one per zone

routines.name: tally_pacing
routines.role: step counter D110 and the 255-iteration delay (skipped when a button is held)

routines.name: tally_award
routines.role: score add via $262F, continue icon redraw, sound $B4 every 16th step

routines.name: score_add
routines.role: BCD score add, continue award rule (D2C8 dependent)

routines.name: number_draw
routines.role: ring, bonus and score fields: BCD to digits, zero suppression, 1x2 glyph cells

routines.name: fade_slot_reset
routines.role: D492/D494 := bit 6 only (fade to black)

routines.name: palette_upload
routines.role: D496 != 0: D472 -> CRAM (32 bytes)

routines.name: animation_freeze
routines.role: clears four sprite animation slots, D39B (terrain animation pointer), D131/D132

routines.name: object_clear
routines.role: zeroes D300..DBBF, D131/D132

routines.name: camera_clear
routines.role: zeroes D15E..D28F

routines.name: name_table_clear
routines.role: frame wait, name table $3800 x $380 words := 0, VRAM $1800 x 32, SAT buffer Y := $F0

routines.name: fade_engine
routines.role: every 5th frame: per-slot palette step (to white, to black, in from black, in from white, copy)

routines.name: fade_palette_select
routines.role: slot +1 -> table address $B64D + 16*index

routines.name: fade_isr_hook
routines.role: frame interrupt: palette upload, input scan

routines.name: level_reload_branch
routines.role: D293 bit 1: $4FCE, $3175 (title card), $2934 loader, $794F fade-in request

routines.name: act_title_card
routines.role: name-table fills, fade-in request, sound $88, arrows, text, 180-frame hold, fade-out

routines.name: act_title_arrows
routines.role: 29 iterations of two 2x3 arrow blocks sliding along rows 1 and 21

routines.name: act_title_text
routines.role: zone-name object (32x4) then act-number object (12x4) built by the $2D90 name-table animator

routines.name: act_title_zone_table
routines.role: six pointers (bank 19) to the 32x4 zone-name maps

routines.name: act_title_delay
routines.role: DEC BC / JR NZ busy delay (CPU time, not frames)

routines.name: name_table_animator
routines.role: per-update scroller for objects D700.. (modes 0..3)

routines.name: title_tile_loader
routines.role: bank 19, VRAM $2000, tile stream $A7E5
